comment: Natural-language descriptions of activities, embedded once at startup and compared
against what the user is actually doing. Phrasing matters more than keywords here:
the model matches meaning, so 'scrolling an endless social media feed' generalises to
sites nobody listed, which is the whole reason this exists alongside the keyword rules.
Polarity is Productive or Distracting. Keep entries as full activity descriptions, not
bare nouns - 'youtube' embeds poorly, 'watching a video for entertainment' does not.
